cmd:
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN= /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/classic_pullback2.py" -o $D/classic_pullback2.py
chown tbot:tbot $D/classic_pullback2.py; cd $D
for tf in 15m 5m; do rm -f out_pb2_$tf.txt; nohup sudo -u tbot /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python classic_pullback2.py $tf > out_pb2_$tf.txt 2>&1 & done
sleep 5; echo started
